from src.tools import t01v2_look_funnel as funnel
source,ref=audited_result(Path('results/diag_flip_partial_fp203_r01.json'))
records=[json.loads(line.split(': ',1)[1]) for line in Path(source['_meta']['log_path']).read_text().splitlines() if line.startswith('PARTIAL_ENDED_FLIP_FUNNEL_JSON: ')]
assert len(records)==1 and len(records[0]['sources'])==1
unit=records[0]['sources'][0]
groups=[{'field_of_view':unit['field_of_view'],'mode':row['mode'],'provided_sources':[unit['source']['file']],'funnel':row['funnel']} for row in unit['groups']]
table=funnel.markdown({'groups':groups,'unprovided_units':[]})

path=Path('logs/review/diag_flip_partial_fp203_r01.md')
with path.open('x') as stream:stream.write(intro+'\n\n'+table)
summary={'observed_prefix_counts':unit['observed_prefix_counts'],'observed_quota':unit['observed_prefix_actual_quota'],'timing':unit['timing'],'funnel':{row['mode']:{key:{k:v for k,v in val.items() if k!='rejected_examples'} for key,val in row['funnel']['stages'].items()} for row in unit['groups']}}
print(json.dumps(summary,sort_keys=True))
p=Path('STATUS.md')
p.write_text(p.read_text()+'\nEnded-prefix diagnostic diag_flip_partial_fp203_r01 authenticated '+str(unit['observed_prefix_counts']['observed_complete_attempts'])+' recorded attempts; actual observed quota='+json.dumps(unit['observed_prefix_actual_quota'],sort_keys=True)+'.
